newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's crude price down to $21.38 per barrel.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's crude price down to $21.38 per barrel.

text.p: The reference price of Ecuador's crude fell to an average $21.38 per barrel on October 11, down from the $21.39 registered the day before, a spokesman for the state-run Petroecuador oil company said Thursday.
The price is tied to the Alaska North Slope (USG) price and Oman crude price, with different discounts payable in 30 days.
The average price in September was $20.03 per barrel.
Ecuador withdrew from the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) in December 1992.
